base_image.role: NVIDIA PyTorch container; the base the upstream recipe names (recipe/scripts/config.sh BASE_IMAGE), for both build stages
base_image.digest_note: The linux/arm64 manifest of nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.07-py3, resolved anonymously via nvcr.io's token and manifest endpoints on 2026-10-21 (no NGC login required); the same digest the GLM-5.3-Flash TensorFold image pins. Both FROM lines in ./Dockerfile pin it.

upstream_recipe.license_note: The recipe's own code, scripts and documentation are Apache-2.0 (recipe/LICENSE, recipe/NOTICE). Its NOTICE asks redistributors of a modified version to keep the NOTICE and state what changed: recipe/ is unmodified, and the change (0010) is kept and described outside it, in petabridge-patches/ and ./README.md.
upstream_recipe.lock_note: Hashes of every file of the pinned commit (git ls-files), byte-identical to git's blobs (verified file by file against git cat-file). The upstream ships no Dockerfile: it builds its image from a shell heredoc inside recipe/scripts/prepare.sh (lines 175-220). This image folder materializes that heredoc as ./Dockerfile.

petabridge_changes.status: prototype; not built, not run on GPUs
petabridge_changes.dockerfile_origin: Materialized from recipe/scripts/prepare.sh lines 175-220 (the `docker build ... -f - "$ctx"` heredoc) at the pinned commit. Deviations are marked PETABRIDGE: in ./Dockerfile and itemized in ./README.md (build boundary).

patches.applies_after: recipe/patches/0001-0009 (git apply in the TensorFold checkout's root, filename order)
patches.summary: Image and video prompts keep and resume prompt states: per-picture content keys from the vision helper, keyed cache ids, media history marks, the media table attached before a resume's MTP absorb, media on keep segments, a fixed per-image visual-token cap, an optional host-side tower-feature cache, and a "prompt_cache": false request field for exactness checks.

petabridge_changes.tools_note: GPU test tools for the prototype, run against a served endpoint; not part of the image. They import the vendored recipe/tools/client.py.

patch_set_label.label: tf.patches
patch_set_label.origin: recipe/scripts/config.sh image_hash() computed with 0010 placed in recipe/patches/: sha256 over patches/*.patch (0001-0010), the prepare.sh heredoc and the build inputs line, first 12 hex characters. Upstream's own 0001-0009 give f3e1300f4f62 (its published IMAGE_TAG zig-db28187-f3e1300f4f62), reproduced here. ./Dockerfile records the value literally and verifies it in the build stage. tf.kernels is "present", as prepare.sh passes it.

tensorfold.install: git fetch --depth 1 of the commit, git apply of the patches, zig build fatbins install native (./Dockerfile build stage)
tensorfold.license: Apache-2.0 from v0.6.0; code written before v0.6.0 keeps its MIT notice (recipe/NOTICE quotes it)
tensorfold.pin_note: The upstream recipe already pins TF_REF by immutable commit (recipe/scripts/config.sh); the build asserts git rev-parse HEAD equals it.

zig.note: Build stage only; not in the final image. Checked with sha256sum -c in the build.

python_packages.note: The upstream recipe's final-stage installs, kept as-is: version-pinned, not hash-pinned, and huggingface_hub is a range. Pin them by URL and checksum before enabling the build if the supply-chain bar for this image is to match the DeepSeek V4 image's.

runtime_models.note: Weights are NOT in the image. recipe/scripts/prepare.sh downloads the pinned revision into the host Hugging Face cache; the ranks mount it.

target.license: NVIDIA Open Model License, with the Qwen Community License 1.0 as additional information (per its model card; recipe/NOTICE)
target.note: QUANT=nvfp4, the recipe's default, ~124 GiB. The same revision testlab-setup's qwen38-tensorfold deployment pins.

alternate.note: QUANT=int4ar; not exercised by the 0010 prototype.
